title: Source
description: Metadata-only record of an evidence source. Source bodies stay in their system of record; raw content fields (content, body, raw, payload, document, data) are never part of the contract and always fail review. raw_included is optional provenance metadata from a capture component: it records whether the capture record held a body in its system of record, and is never itself treated as a body. observed_at is when the evidence was observed or snapshotted; source_updated_at is the last-modified time reported by the source system and drives the stale_source_content check. Capture provenance extensions (kind, adapter, key, locator, access_caveats, fields, raw_included) are accepted for Capture compatibility.

id.description: Stable identifier for the source record within the artifact.

kind.description: Capture kind when the record came from a capture component.

type.description: Source kind: jira, decision-log, meeting-note, or any explicit label.

adapter.description: Capture adapter that produced the record.

key.description: Capture key within the adapter (for example the ticket key).

url.description: Absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL to the source of record.

path.description: Optional file path for local sources.

observed_at.description: When the evidence was observed or snapshotted. Full RFC3339 datetime with Z or UTC offset. Age beyond max_observation_age_days raises stale_observation.

source_updated_at.description: Last-modified time reported by the source system; full RFC3339 datetime with Z or UTC offset. Age beyond max_source_content_age_days raises stale_source_content.

owner.description: Human or team accountable for this source record.

revision.description: Optional source revision at capture time.

content_hash.description: Optional sha256 content hash in canonical 64-hex form, with or without a sha256: prefix.

locator.description: Concrete pointer (URL, path, key) to the source of record.

access_caveats.description: Capture caveats about access to the source.

fields.description: Structured fields extracted by capture; never the raw body.

raw_included.description: Optional provenance metadata: whether the capture record held a raw body in its system of record. The body itself never travels in this artifact; raw_included is metadata only and never treated as a raw body.
